item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents
item.description: AI coding agents operate without persistent memory; useful outputs produced in one session are unavailable in the next, and information from one project never transfers to another. We present DevMemory, a structured memory management architecture that brings trust-scored, cross-scope knowledge retrieval to AI coding agents. item.title: Civilization Engineering A Generative Architecture for Building Civilizations through Text, Models, Knowledge, Institutions, Memory, and Intergenerational Handoff
item.description: Description Civilization Engineering develops a systematic framework for studying how civilizations can be intentionally shaped, tested, preserved, revised, and transmitted across generations. The central proposition is that civilizations are not produced only by governments, technologies, economies, or historical accidents. They are also generated through interacting systems of values, language, narratives, models, protocols, institutions, practices, memory, and inheritance. Civilization Engine

item.description: Abstract Urban drainage model calibration requires coordinating data preparation, parameter screening, simulation, validation and interpretation, and remains slow and expertise-intensive. item.title: Generative debunking of climate misinformation
item.description: Abstract Misinformation is a persistent roadblock to progress on climate change, and the ubiquitous, rapid spread of misinformation means that manual solutions are inadequate to meet the scale of the problem. item.title: Agentic AI for Digital Product Passport Documentation: A Feasibility Study on Heterogeneous Manufacturing Documents
item.description: Digital Product Passports (DPPs) are intended to make lifecycle product information accessible across the value chain and enable circular business models.
